en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_daily_ongoing: The card game on the booked-out floor runs as usual, with $names$ on call.
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_daily_result: The man with the worst hand at the table drags $names$ over.
en-us.event_erav_gang_daily_01:
Convenience-store bags of food sit on the low table. Mid-game, whoever's luck has gone cold drags her over to "turn his luck around".
"Ground rules first, boys: she's debt labour, not a free ride. Go easy - you break her, you pay for her."
"Got it--!"
en-us.event_erav_gang_daily_02: Under the low table she keeps dealing his tiles with him in her mouth. Whoever wins the hand gets to go first.
en-us.event_erav_gang_daily_03:
On the shared sleeping platform the line stretches toward the corridor. The man in front isn't finished before the one behind is already waiting, watching and handling himself.
Tatami, windowsill, corridor, the bathhouse's changing bench - in the gaps between uses she is ordered to hold herself open and wait, "to save some foreplay effort".
en-us.event_erav_gang_daily_04:
Deep in the night, the girl in the middle of the platform is arranged into position. Half asleep, she is entered, filled; when it's over a hand pats her hip and its owner rolls over to sleep.
She doesn't even spare the strength to open her eyes; her body keeps pace with the rhythm in the dark on its own.
